DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) due to prematurity (born at 32 weeks).

The clinical picture—prematurity, respiratory acidosis on ABG, and classic "ground-glass" chest X-ray findings—is diagnostic. The cesarean delivery and maternal gestational diabetes are consistent risk factors, but the primary pathology is surfactant deficiency.
